title: Example Scheduler vision
description: Fictional example of the Example Scheduler, a made-up job scheduler; not a description of any real system.

entities.title: Jobs run on time, and someone knows when they don't
entities.summary: A small team's scheduled jobs run reliably, and every failure reaches a person who can act on it.
entities.problem: Jobs live in crontabs on three machines, fail silently and are rediscovered weeks later.
entities.outcome: Every job is registered in one place, runs at most once per schedule slot and reports its outcome.
successMeasures: No silent failures for a quarter
A new job is added in under ten minutes
entities.shutDownWhen: The hosting platform offers the same guarantees
